'''Dakkar''' was the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] proprietor of the [[Jaded Jawa]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] in the [[Kothlis Starport]].
==History==
By [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] Dakkar was considered aged.<ref>The ''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]'' describes Dakkar as "well-past his prime". According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''[[Shadows of the Empire]]'' occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> In the past he had suffered a wound on his left eye.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] he had the double job of [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]] , and proprietor of the ''[[Jaded Jawa]]'' [[Cantina/Legends|bar]]. The cantina was located in the main terminal of the [[Kothlis Starport]], a hotspot for information.<ref name="guide" />

Dakkar had a special procedure when buying and selling information. Ordering "[[Ragnook Spring Water]]" was a signal that the customer was selling information, and discreetly showed a [[datapad/Legends|datapad]] highlighting the topic; if Dakakr was interested, he recommended another drink, with a price indication how much he'd pay.<ref name="guide" />

Conversely, someone selling information had to order an "[[Antakarian Fire Dancer]]", 
followed by a question. If Dakkar knew about it, he'd reply with the "drink's" price. After payment with a [[Credit chip/Legends|credit stick]], he provided a drinking mat, which was actually a datapad with the information.<ref name="guide" />
==Personality and traits==
Dakkar had black fur, braided with several beads. His left wounded eye had a permanent squint.<ref name="guide" />
